questions.solution:

Logic: 1st number **÷** 8 = 2nd number.

For, 104 ∶ 13

⇒ 104 ÷ 8 = 13

Similarly, for **152 ∶ ?**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13-Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(2, 6, 8)

(117, 351, 468)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number - 1st number) × 2 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (2, 6, 8)

⇒ (6 - 2) × 2 

⇒ 4 × 2 = 8.

For, (117, 351, 468) 

⇒ (351 - 117) × 2

⇒ 234 × 2 = 468.

Similarly, for **(4, 12, 16)**

**⇒ (12 - 4) × 2**

**⇒ 8 × 2 = 16.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. Price of J is less than U, M and N. Price of B is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of U is less than M. Price of neither U nor M is the highest. Price of how many cars is less than the price of U?
questions.solution:
Given: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. No two cars have the same price.

1) Price of B is the least. 

__ > __ > __ > __ > B

2) Price of J is less than U, M and N.

3) Price of neither U nor M is the highest. 

N > U/M > M/U > J > B

4) Price of U is less than M.

N > M > U > J > B

So, Price of '2' cars is less than the price of U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No watch is pen.

II. All pen are green.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some green are pen.

II. All green are watch.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. No watch is pen.

II. All pen are green.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3a2760f48d60355235a1284db0d249b4d28d79445e0c311efff756195ecc9ff.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some green are pen - True (Because, All Pen are green, it implies that some green are also pen).

II. All green are watch - False (Because, Those part of pen which is green will never watch).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
After interchanging the which two numbers, the value of the given equation will be '20'?

8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7
questions.solution:
Given equation: 8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7 = 20

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 6 and 7

Given: 8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7 = 20

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 8 × 2 + __**7 ÷ 3**__ - 6 = 20

⇒ __**8 × 2**__ + 2.33 - 6 = 20

⇒ **__16 __**__**+ 2.33**__ - 6 = 20

⇒ 18.33 - 6 = 20

⇒ 12.33 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 8 and 7

Given: 8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7 = 20

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 7 × 2 + __**6 ÷ 3**__ - 8 = 20

⇒ __**7 × 2**__ + 2 - 8 = 20

⇒ __**14 + 2**__ - 8 = 20

⇒ __16 -____ 8__ = 20

⇒ 8 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 2 and 6

Given: 8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7 = 20

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 8 × 6 + __**2 ÷ 3**__ - 7 = 20

⇒ __**8 × 6**__ + 0.66 - 7 = 20

⇒ __**48 + 0.66**__ - 7 = 20

⇒ __48.66** - 7**__ = 20

⇒ 41.66 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 4) 2 and 3**

Given: 8 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 - 7 = 20

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 8 × 3 + __**6 ÷ 2**__ - 7 = 20

⇒ __**8 × 3**__ + 3 - 7 = 20

⇒ __**24 + 3**__ - 7 = 20

⇒ __**27 - 7**__ = 20

⇒ **20 = 20**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Mansi is third to the left of Monika. Aarti is second to the right of Monika. Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal. Payal is second to the left of Mansi. Rani is third to the right of Kajal. Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi. Who is second to the left of Monika?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Mansi is third to the left of Monika.

2) Aarti is second to the right of Monika.

3) Payal is second to the left of Mansi.

4) Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e472507f39aae23374a212eb1acb60e5cf9e2e080b216b46f5ed67da08451f.png] 

5) Rani is third to the right of Kajal.

6) Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi.

And, Laxmi will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f0ed85add21b39f37b83462b4a935eb19a37f507116716795e25cba093dd9c.png] 

Here, "Laxmi" is second to the left of Monika.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
